name: empty-plan
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Walking the questions: the active questions are the plan variables plus every variable of every active section. A plan with neither has none

name: reading-order
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Order: plan variables first, then each active section's questions in document order. ordering.md: timing, then after, then id. Declaration order inside a section is the order of the variables list

name: inactive-sections
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a switched-off section is not active and its questions are not asked. conditions.md: includeIf false puts the section out. A section clause tests the switch only. No question is listed for the switch

name: audience-split
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: a variable has an audience, onboarder by default, and either scope can have either. Every active question is listed whoever answers it, in one order. A named audience lists its own questions, and its blockers are its own required questions with no answer. docs/reference/section-template-schema/variables.md, Audience

name: kinds-and-defaults
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/variables.md, Fields: type is string by default, audience is onboarder by default. docs/reference/domain-model.md, Question: type and audience are not optional

name: answers-as-stored
source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Question: answer is the stored answer, if any. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: the Text deferred differs from the Deferred kind

name: defaults-are-suggestions
source: docs/decisions/0045-defaults-are-suggestions.md: a default is a suggestion, never an answer. A question with a default and no answer is unanswered, and a required one blocks

name: blockers
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Where the behavior lives: Blockers lists active required questions with no answer, for an audience. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: a required question is satisfied by a settled or a deferred answer, unanswered blocks. A false flag is settled

name: ask-if-tests
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Answer tests and Rules: every test except isSettled is false for a deferred or unanswered question, a default is not an answer, a false flag is settled, an empty all always holds. The finder evaluates askIf through the condition evaluator

name: ask-if-scope
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Syntax: a bare name is a question in the same section, plan.<name> is a plan variable. contracts/condition/evaluator/contract.md, Finding the answer: a bare name never falls back

name: ask-if-section-clause
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a question's askIf may test whether a section is on. The clause tests the switch only. A section with no enabled field is on. The switches are those of every section of the plan

name: ask-if-inactive-answers
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Rules: a settled answer is one for a question that is active and has a stored answer. docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Conditions: a question whose condition is false keeps its answer, is not asked

name: order-condition-names-later-section
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/ordering.md, Question order in the walkthrough: if a condition refers to a later section, the finder moves the dependent question to just after the question it needs

name: order-condition-names-later-question
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Order: a question is never asked before the questions its condition names. ordering.md, Question order in the walkthrough

name: order-ignores-questions-not-asked
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Order: a question is never asked before the questions its condition names. A question that is not asked is not a constraint. Decision to know in contract.md

name: ask-if-cycle
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/ordering.md, Question order in the walkthrough: a cycle is reported as a problem and not resolved. The plan validator reports it. Decision to know in contract.md

name: groups
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Groups: questions with the same name, type, options, and multiple form a group. docs/reference/domain-model.md, Question: group is the key shared by those questions

name: suggestions-defaults
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: the distinct declared defaults in its group. Decision to know in contract.md for questions that are not active

name: suggestions-given
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: the answers already given for that name in any scope, the plan's and every section's, inactive ones included

name: suggestions-default-and-given
source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Suggestion: source is default or given. Decision to know in contract.md for a value that is both

name: suggestions-valid-values
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: for a boolean or choice only valid values are offered. contract.md, Rules, for the kind each type holds

name: suggestions-pattern
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: for a string with a pattern, a candidate that does not match is dropped. variables.md: pattern is RE2 syntax

name: suggestions-settled-only
source: docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: unanswered and deferred are not settled. docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Entry rules: deferred is offered as its own entry, not as a suggestion

name: suggestions-lists
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/variables.md, Types and Person: a command and a person with multiple hold a list, a person holds one text line, and same-name person variables group and offer an earlier entry

name: acme
source: docs/reference/examples/acme, as contracts/plan/testdata/acme.plan.json. Expected questions written by hand from the plan: the software discipline leaves out review-design-system, account_name is an onboardee question and is asked in the full list, tracker_grantor is deferred

name: audience-ask-if
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: a question is active by its own condition, whoever answers it, so an onboarder question may depend on an onboardee answer, and the other way round. Conditions are unchanged: a condition on an unanswered question is false. docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, order: a question comes after the question it needs. conditions.md: a settled answer is one for a question that is active

name: audience-blockers
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: blockers are per audience, a required onboardee question does not block the onboarder, and an answer already in the file is respected. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: settled or deferred satisfies a required question. 0050: an off or left-out section is not asked

name: audience-section-choice
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Context and Rules: a plan variable may have audience onboardee and its answer chooses sections through includeIf, and the evaluator needs no change. conditions.md: includeIf reads the stored plan answers

name: audience-unanswered-choice
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: a condition on an unanswered question is false, so sections that depend on an onboardee answer stay out until the answer exists, and a required onboardee question does not block the onboarder

name: audience-suggestions
source: docs/decisions/0045-defaults-are-suggestions.md: the defaults of the questions in the group and the answers already given for the name, in any scope. docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md: scope and audience are separate, and the finder lists questions by audience only. Written by hand from the plan

name: examples
source: The example field change (model.Variable.Example and model.Question.Example): a variable has an optional example, one illustration of a good answer, empty when absent, and its question carries it. Nothing fills it in or accepts it as an answer or a default. The group key, activity, order, suggestions and blockers do not use it. Written by hand from the plan
